title: SCUS_973.16 Sly 2: Band of Thieves (NTSC-U)
note: Reverse-engineered EE RAM facts for the navigator (hle/nav_probe.h). Found by RAM diffs of the Paris hub (nav_hunt.py; nav_notes.md). World: x,y horizontal, z UP (Sucker Punch engine units; Sly ~190 tall, ground of the spawn roof z=532). chain = [static address, offset after deref, ...]; a one-element chain is a static variable.

probes.name: pos_x
probes.note: player root bone world position (block +0x70); [0x2de1a0] = the level/world object (0xfb1580 in Paris), the player's transform blocks follow it at fixed offsets

probes.name: yaw
probes.note: player character-root world matrix row0 (x,y) -> facing, degrees

probes.name: cam_yaw
probes.note: camera orientation matrix row0 = forward (x,y,z); yaw degrees

probes.name: cam_orbit_yaw
probes.note: yaw of (camera - target), radians -> degrees (= cam_yaw - 180)

probes.name: level_time
probes.note: seconds since the level started (0x2dded0 family)

probes.name: cam_fwd_x
probes.note: camera orientation matrix row0 = forward unit vector (x,y,z); row1 = LEFT (screen right = -row1), row2 = up; the frustum half-tangents are 0x2ddf80 (horizontal 0.796) and 0x2ddf84 (vertical 0.613) at 512x448: pixel = (256 + 256*(d.right/d.fwd)/0.796, 224 - 224*(d.up/d.fwd)/0.613)
